documentationFeedback: docs/kubernetes.md:130 and packages/daemon/docker/worker.Dockerfile's comment above its probe step (`probe-image: OK (…) agent-models=skipped capabilities=checked model-fallback=off daemon-api-version=<N>`) say the image build's OK line reads `model-fallback=off`. Oh My Pi 18.6.0 defaults `retry.modelFallback` to true (`omp config get retry.modelFallback --json` with PI_CONFIG_FILES unset answers value true), so the build, which has no operator configuration, prints `model-fallback=on` — Worker Image runs 37736231904 and 37737281790 did, and so did the published image's probe run in its rootfs here; only an operator overlay such as the deployment's turns it off. Both sentences should say `on`. A wording fix for this pull request (the architect's decision, envoy 4978d00bc144ddd54f6b740df4e96b2f).
